messages.subject: Re: improving model fit with fit indices
parts:
It sounds as if you have already figured out how to obtain modification indices using lavaan. If so, your question is not specific to lavaan and is probably too broad to allow a helpful reply on an email distribution list.

As a general rule, modifications indices should not be used in isolation but instead considered along with other information in a broader process of model respecification.  Modification indices estimate the improvement in chi-square expected if a fixed parameter were freely estimated.

Rex Kline's introductory SEM book contains material on model respecification including the use of modification indices, scattered across several chapters.  Both terms appear in the subject index.  The book also provides references to additional literature.

Kline, R. B. (2016).  Principles and practice of structural equation modeling (4th ed.).  New York:  Guilford.

Keith Markus
